name: OpenAI Transcribe
blurb: OpenAI’s dedicated transcription family — GPT-4o Transcribe, mini, and diarization, with Realtime transcription support.
about: OpenAI’s current transcription family includes GPT-4o Transcribe, GPT-4o mini Transcribe, and GPT-4o Transcribe Diarize. The models are designed specifically for speech-to-text, with improved recognition and language handling over the original Whisper models; the diarization variant identifies different speakers in a conversation.

The API is cloud-hosted and priced by audio tokens: GPT-4o Transcribe uses $2.50 per 1M input audio tokens plus $10 per 1M output tokens, while mini uses $1.25 and $5 respectively. OpenAI also lists GPT-Realtime-Whisper for streaming transcription. These models are not present in the current Open ASR result export, so this catalogue does not assign a WER. Prices and model availability can change — check the OpenAI documentation before deployment.
install:
pip install -U openai

python -c "from openai import OpenAI; c=OpenAI(); print(c.audio.transcriptions.create(model='gpt-4o-transcribe', file=open('audio.wav','rb')).text)"
